definitions.explanation: A reference book containing words and their meanings.

examples.japanese: {字引|じびき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
{字引|じびき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up a word in the dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{字引|じびき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

examples.english: There is a large dictionary at my grandfather's house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{字引|じびき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This dictionary is old, but it's convenient for looking up kanji readings.

notes:
{字引|じびき} is an older term for a dictionary, now largely replaced by ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧ in everyday speech. You may encounter it in older literature, from elderly speakers, or in set expressions.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character) + ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull/look up). The name reflects the act of looking up characters.

MODERN ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary (most common, general purpose)
- ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: dictionary (larger reference works, e.g., ⟦{国語|こくご}{辞典|じてん}→国語辞典：23277_kokugojiten⟧)
- ⟦{事典|じてん}→事典：21891_jiten⟧: encyclopedia (same reading as {辞典|じてん} but different kanji)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字引|じびき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to consult a dictionary

REGISTER:
Somewhat archaic. Understood by all Japanese speakers but rarely used by younger generations.
